prompts.text:
You are drafting one section of a consultation note.

Patient context (from structured intake; blank where not supplied):
Age: 64
Sex: female

Task:
Write the requested section using only the referral below, following the section standard.

Guardrail:
Do not add clinical facts the referral does not contain. Where the referral is silent, say so plainly.

Output rule:
Return only prose for the requested section. Do not include a heading, JSON, markdown, bullets, or commentary.

Requested section:
Assessment

Section standard:
One paragraph of prose. State the working impression and the reasoning that supports it, drawing only on what the referral documents. Name the competing possibilities that the referral raises and say briefly why each is more or less likely. Where the referral does not document something the impression would ordinarily rest on, say that it is not documented rather than inferring it. No headings or lists; paragraphs only.


Referral:
Eileen Murphy admitted with community-acquired pneumonia; now afebrile on oral amoxicillin. Mobilising with a frame; physiotherapy and a home assessment before discharge. (Fictional.)
